body:
Quantum Gravity Discovery Network. Coordinates theoretical research and experiments aimed at connecting quantum mechanics with gravity.

This database covers the technology as item 216 entry 41 of Manon's "100 Technologies Beyond Omega (B)" catalog, section "Spacetime, Gravity, and the Deepest Physics". It is the public edition: every factual claim below is drawn from real public science and engineering, honestly labeled.

Feasibility tier: theoretically plausible. QG research is real and coordinated (conferences, programs); discovery is unachieved.

Classification: public database. This record profiles the technology; companion records cover known science, constraints, approaches, tools, unresolved problems, evidence, and outlook.

title: Quantum Gravity Discovery Network - Known Science Foundations
description: Public edition: Coordinates theoretical research and experiments aimed at connecting quantum mechanics with gravity.
body:
Known science foundations of Quantum Gravity Discovery Network.

String theory, LQG, and asymptotic safety are active. Tabletop experiments probe gravity-quantum interfaces. But connecting QM and gravity — discovery — remains the deepest unsolved problem in physics.

Key quantity check (QG papers per year / QG discoveries): computed ratio 4000 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.5. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.
